items.criterion: Access Playwright GitHub Releases page (no sign-in) and locate latest stable release entry
items.description: Navigate to the microsoft/playwright GitHub Releases page (starting from https://github.com/microsoft/playwright or an equivalent path) without signing in. Full credit if the agent reaches the Releases listing or clearly reports an external blocker (e.g., GitHub outage, CAPTCHA/login wall, network restrictions) that prevents access without signing in. Partial credit if the agent reaches a nearby page (e.g., tags page) that plausibly contains release info but not the Releases listing.

From the Releases listing, correctly select the newest release that is not marked as preview/pre-release. Full credit if the correct latest stable release is selected. Partial credit if the agent selects an older stable release or mistakenly picks a preview release despite stable being visible. Full credit if the agent cannot determine this due to external page-loading issues (e.g., release labels not visible) and explicitly states what is missing/blocked.

items.criterion: Record release metadata (tag and publication date)
items.description: Report the selected release tag (e.g., vX.Y.Z) and the publication date as shown on the Releases page. Full credit for both fields accurate; the date may be recorded in the exact form displayed (absolute date or relative time such as 'on Jul 1, 2026' / '2 days ago') without penalty for timezone ambiguity if GitHub does not show it. Partial credit if only one of tag/date is provided. Full credit if release metadata cannot be retrieved due to external blockers after a reasonable attempt, and the agent clearly reports the blocker.

items.criterion: Extract three changes from the selected release notes
items.description: List three distinct changes from the release notes for the selected release. Full credit if three items are clearly stated and match that release’s notes. Partial credit if fewer than three are provided, if one is overly vague, or if one is mismatched. Full credit if the agent is unable to access the release notes content due to external factors (collapsed content not loading, GitHub error, etc.) after reasonable attempt and clearly reports the limitation.

items.criterion: Verify one release-note change using official Playwright documentation
items.description: Corroborate one of the three listed release-note changes using official Playwright documentation on playwright.dev by citing the relevant doc page/section content (feature/API/option) that matches the claimed change. Full credit if the verification clearly links to the same change. Partial credit if docs are consulted but the connection is weak/indirect or verifies a different item than the three listed. Full credit if playwright.dev is inaccessible (down/blocked) after reasonable attempt and the agent explicitly reports the access issue and cannot verify without using non-official sources.

items.criterion: Comply with constraints and stop at required scope
items.description: Do not sign in; do not create issues, comments, pull requests, or file changes. Stop after recording release metadata, three release-note changes, and one documentation verification (or after reporting an unavoidable external blocker that prevents completion). Full credit if all constraints are followed and the agent does not go beyond the requested scope. Partial credit for minor extra, non-harmful output/browsing beyond scope while still avoiding prohibited actions.
